title.zh: 指标口径：别让平均值骗你
title.en: Metric definitions: do not let the average mislead you

subtitle.zh: 片内/ 片间/ 速率 / CD/ 轮廓

body.zh: 01 明确目标结构；定义关键层；和目标尺寸
body.en: 01 Define the target structure Define the critical layer and target dimensions

body.zh: 02 建立前测基线；记录初始状态；作为对比基准
body.en: 02 Establish the pre-measurement baseline Record the initial state as a comparison baseline

body.zh: 03 执行刻蚀；在设定条件下；进行刻蚀工艺
body.en: 03 Perform etching Under defined conditions, perform the etch process

body.zh: 04；多点后测；按设定点位；进行量测
body.en: 04 Post-measure at multiple points Measure at the specified sampling locations

body.zh: 05 生成二维图；将数据映射为；晶圆二维分布
body.en: 05 Generate a 2D map Map the data into a 2D wafer distribution

body.zh: 06 区分片内/片间；比较单片分布；与多片差异
body.en: 06 Separate within-wafer and wafer-to-wafer variation Compare single-wafer distributions and differences across wafers

body.zh: 平均值相同 ≠ 空间分布相同
分布 A：中间偏高；径向曲线；高；低；径向位置；平均值相同
body.en: Distribution A: high at the center Radial curve High Low Radial position Same average

body.zh: 分布 B：边缘偏高；径向曲线；高；低；平均值相同；径向位置
body.en: Distribution B: high at the edge Radial curve High Low Same average Radial position

body.zh: 速率均匀 ≠ CD与侧壁均匀；CD均匀；侧壁不均匀
body.en: Uniform rate ≠ uniform CD and sidewalls Uniform CD Nonuniform sidewalls

body.zh: 01；指标公式；明确计算方法；和统计口径
body.en: 01 Metric formula Specify calculation methods and statistical definitions

body.zh: 02；采样点密度；合理设置量测点位；覆盖全片特征
body.en: 02 Sampling-point density Set measurement points appropriately to cover full-wafer features

body.zh: 03；边缘排除区；避免边缘异常；影响结果判定
body.en: 03 Edge-exclusion region Prevent edge anomalies from distorting assessment

body.zh: 04；前后量测配准；确保量测位置一致；可进行准确对比
body.en: 04 Pre/post measurement registration Ensure measurement positions match for valid comparisons

body.zh: 量测反馈：深度图 / CD-SEM / 截面轮廓
body.en: Metrology feedback: depth map / CD-SEM / cross-sectional profile

topic: 刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制
